title: Co-Creation interview with Mike Morrell

body:
The Servant Leadership School of Greensboro has invited me, Diana Butler-Bass, and Integral Christianity author Paul Smith to join them in Greensboro in a few weeks, this coming April 12th-15th. We’ll each be sharing, from our unique perspectives, on Co-Creation with God, summed up in this event’s subtitle: The Great Emergence and the Spirit’s Call to Evolve. – evolving toward ever-increasing empathy, wholeness, and energy to confront the challenges and opportunities facing people of faith in the world today. We’ll be joined by an excellent ensemble of bands, visual artists, musicians and roundtable discussion that should make Co-Creation a time of deep encouragement for the journey we’re all on.

 Mike Morrell caught up with me recently to chat about Co-Creation, my recent short story releases, loving our theological enemies, and the rich legacy of the servant leadership/Church of the Saviour model of leadership development. It’s only 15 minutes; give it a listen here .

If you’d like to come out to Greensboro I’d love to see you. You can register for all four days or individual sessions here: http://co-creation2012.eventbrite.com/

Mention my name (“BRIANMCLAREN”) at checkout and save 10% on registration between now and next Friday, April 6th, at midnight.

So many good things going on!
